survivors.description: Lower bound of keep is 1 instead of 0, so short max_len keeps a text character.
survivors.diff:
--- a/src/textutil/trunc.py
+++ b/src/textutil/trunc.py
@@ -16,3 +16,3 @@
         return text
-    keep = max(max_len - len(ellipsis), 0)
+    keep = max(max_len - len(ellipsis), 1)
     return (text[:keep] + ellipsis)[:max_len]
survivors.words: src/textutil/trunc.py:17: changing `    keep = max(max_len - len(ellipsis), 0)` to `    keep = max(max_len - len(ellipsis), 1)` made no test fail; it behaves differently from the fix on inputs no test checks
